cpu: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S
keyed_chain: Fresh 50k and 200k seeds, REPEATS=3, batch=1000. First 50k samples overlapped the six-second two-client overlap probe; later 200k samples had no other owned benchmark running.
inspection_chain_concurrent: Overlapped the wide bootstrap and the scale-1 planning smoke. Case names cached/recached mean immediate repeats; they do not prove a cache hit. The revised harness names them immediate_repeat.
planning_smoke: The actual 116-node DuckDB fixture, scale=1. Its scale changes row counts, not partition-key count. Peak tree/largest-process RSS are not native coordinator-only RSS.
wide: Synthetic 1000-asset graph derived from repeated/truncated planning skeleton, 2209 edges, 1200 keys/node. Replaces tasks with JSON-producing assets. Not the real planning workload or a production replay.
limits: Linux measurements under ambient machine load, no pinned affinity or isolated CPU. Single cold seed per size; retain all warm samples. Not a performance guarantee or controlled comparison to historical 0.33 timings.
wide_concurrent_load: Seed overlapped the first chain inspection, planning smoke, docs site build and later help-PR compile. Refresh overlaps wide inspection and help-PR test compilation. These are loaded-machine measurements, not isolated latency budgets.
